author: visegrad24
text:
🇨🇳🇺🇸 China sends two more pandas to America

Xi Jinping said two new pandas, male Pingping and female Fushuang, will soon arrive in the United States at Zoo Atlanta as part of China’s panda diplomacy.

“The giant panda has been an envoy of friendship between the Chinese and Americans. Here, I have a piece of good news. In a few days, two pandas, Pingping and Fushuang, will come to their new home in Zoo Atlanta and meet with the American people.”
